name: bld2_card_le_sum_of_prod_eq_one
statement: (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → R) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hp : ∏ i ∈ s, a i = 1) : (s.card : R) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i
closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → R) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hp : ∏ i ∈ s, a i = 1), (s.card : R) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_an_amgm_finset_ordered_ring: with ∏ a = 1 the AM-GM inequality reads card^card ≤ (∑ a)^card; both bases are nonnegative, so for s nonempty taking card-th roots (pow_le_pow_left contrapositive) gives card ≤ ∑ a; s empty is trivial.
type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (ι : Type u_2) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → R), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) → ∏ i ∈ s, a i = 1 → ↑s.card ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i
